caption: The drawing depicts a single three-legged cauldron with a rounded base and a wide opening at the top, rendered in shades of gray and black on a light, slightly yellowed background. The cauldron has a large, curved handle that arches upward and attaches to the rim on opposite sides. The body of the cauldron shows subtle textural details and shading, suggesting a metallic surface, with faint lines indicating seams or cracks. The three legs are evenly spaced and extend downwards, supporting the cauldron. There are no other objects present in the composition, and the background remains plain and unadorned. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Kettle
